ABOUT

Welcome to MeSoKawaii — So Cute! 🌈💫
After years as MeSoKawaii Squishy Shop, I’m saying goodbye to the squishy chapter and stepping into a fresh new direction that’s just as cute (if not cuter!). 💕

While I phase out my remaining stock of squishies, I’m excited to focus on what truly lights me up—designing and creating adorable stationery, charming digital art, and feel-good creative goods that inspire joy. ✏️🎨✨

This rebrand is about more than just products—it's about embracing creativity, consistency, and kawaii expression in all forms.

Thank you for being here as MeSoKawaii continues to evolve. Change is happening—and it’s so cute! 🌸💖
